hooks.name: Keep the sense list in sync
hooks.description: When a sense file changes, the list of sense names in steering and the skill must still match what the code registers.

action.prompt: A sense file just changed. Run `node core/bin/ghost-crew.js senses` and compare its names with the sense lists in .kiro/steering/ghost-authoring.md and kirocrew-app/skills/ghost-crew/SKILL.md. If a name was added, removed or renamed, update both lists to match exactly. Do not change any code for this.
